'''Tundra Dowmeia''' was a [[Quarren]] who served as the [[senator]] of [[Mon Cala]] during the [[Clone Wars]], replacing Senator [[Tikkes]] in the [[Galactic Senate|Republic Senate]] after his defection to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. By the end of the [[Clone Wars]], Dowmeia was joined by [[Mon Calamari]] [[Meena Tills]] in representing their homeworld.<ref name="USW" />

==Biography==
Tundra Dowmeia was a [[Quarren]] who became [[Senator|reprentative]] in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] for the [[planet]] [[Mon Cala]], [[homeworld]] of both the Quarren and [[Mon Calamari]],<ref name="Separatists">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Separatists}}</ref> in [[22 BBY]].<ref name="22BBY">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Separatists}} states that Tundra Dowmeia becomes [[senator]] for [[Mon Cala]] after the [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|assassination attempt]] on [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] and before the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates both of these events to [[22 BBY]].</ref> Dowmeia replaced fellow Quarren [[Tikkes]] after he defected to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] shortly after an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala|attempt]] was made to [[assassin]]ate the Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]]. Tikkes attempted to bring all of Mon Cala with him in his defection, but some Mon Calamari and Quarren instead reaffirmed their loyalty to the Republic and selected Dowmeia as the new Senator. Dowmeia entered office just in [[time]]<ref name="Separatists" /> to stand in a [[repulsorpod]] in the [[Imperial Senate Building|Galactic Senate Building]] on the Republic [[capital]] [[Coruscant]] and witness [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] announce the creation of a [[Grand Army of the Republic]], which then engaged the Separatists in a [[First Battle of Geonosis|battle]] on the planet [[Geonosis]], beginning the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

[[File:TundraDowmeia-SWCT.png|thumb|left|200px|Senator Tundra Dowmeia]]
By [[20 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> the Mon Calamari [[Meena Tills]] had become sole representative of Mon Cala in the Senate,<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> with the Quarren and Mon Calamari struggling to maintain a fragile co-existence on their homeworld. After both Republic and Separatist envoys were sent to project their influence on the world, the planet's [[King]] [[Yos Kolina]] was [[Death|assassinated]] causing civil war to break out. The [[Quarren Isolation League]] initially sided with the Separatists in the ensuing [[Battle of Mon Cala]], but ultimately fought alongside the Mon Calamari for the Republic, with their combined forces achieving victory.<ref name="Battles">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref> Following the settlement of the hostilies between the Quarren and Mon Calamari, Tills shared representation of Mon Cala<ref name="SWE">{{SWE|characters|meenatills|Meena Tills}}</ref> with Dowmeia.<ref name="VE" />

Both Dowmeia and Tills joined the [[Delegation of 2,000]], a group of senators who were concerned with Palpatine's growing power throughout the conflict and wished for him to relinquish the [[Emergency Powers Act|emergency powers]] he had been granted.<ref name="VE" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas" /> the Separatists launched a massive [[Battle of Coruscant|invasion]] of Coruscant and captured the Supreme Chancellor, who was then rescued by the [[Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Following the battle, Dowmeia and Tills, as well as<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> the Quarren's [[aide]] [[Cellheim Anujo]],<ref name="VE" /> were part of a group that greeted Palpatine as he was returned to the [[Imperial Executive Building|Senate Office Building]] in a [[Util-313]] [[speeder bus]]. Waiting on the building's landing platform, the reception moved forward toward Palpatine as he disembarked and then followed him into the building. Dowmeia was later present at Coruscant's.<ref name="Episode III" /> [[Galaxies Opera House]]<ref name="USW" /> in the company of a [[Twi'lek]] during a recital<ref name="Episode III" /> of [[Squid Lake]], a Mon Calamari [[opera]].<ref name="USW" /> Skywalker raced past the Quarren in one of the opera house's corridors on his way to see Palpatine.<ref name="Episode III" />

[[File:DacPalaceInterior-2017DarthVader13.png|thumb|right|300px|Dowmeia attended the negotiations between Ambassador Telvar and King Lee-Char.]]
Not long after the [[opera]] recital, the Clone Wars ended with the defeat of the Separatists and the [[Proclamation of the New Order|reformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Episode III" /> A year into the [[Imperial Era]]<ref name="DV13">[[Darth Vader (2017) 13|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 13]]</ref> in [[18 BBY]],<ref name="18BBY">[[Darth Vader (2017) 13|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 13]] dates its events to one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Proclamation of the New Order]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. The events of ''Darth Vader'' 13 must therefore take place in [[18 BBY]].</ref> Mon Cala was defiant against the Empire and negotiations were taking place between the world's [[king]], [[Lee-Char]], and Imperial [[ambassador]] [[Telvar]]. With peace between the Quarren and Mon Calamari, Dowmeia also attended the negotiations in [[Dac City]] on Mon Cala's surface and witnessed Lee-Char turn down a trade proposal that would have required Mon Cala to sell [[kelpite strand beam]]s to the Empire at any quantity at a fraction of the market price. Telvar then left Dac City with the hope of later resuming negotiations, but was killed in a [[shuttle]] explosion that the Empire then used as justification to [[Invasion of Mon Cala|subjugate]] Mon Cala.<ref name="DV13" />
